    | text      = Daddy shark.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:16.959
    | text      = Bomp, bomp, bomp, bomp, bomp.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:17.959
    | text      = Jar Jar Binks has a Caribbean black accent.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = He's a loser, little, little titty baby.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = I don't want to hate black people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:26.959
    | text      = I renounce Jesus Christ.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:28.959
    | text      = It's too bad that I'm cold reading these because otherwise I could have loaded up the Lionel theme song.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = That would have been good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:34.959
    | text      = But oh well.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Well you can't have everything with a cold read.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = But Lionel, Lionel, Lionel, Lionel.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:06:42.959

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:06:43.959
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:44.959
    | text      = So before we get to this episode I'd like to play for you an out of context drop from today's show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:52.959
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:53.959
    | text      = Well I mean.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:54.959
    | text      = They say snitches get stitches.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:56.959
    | text      = They do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:57.959
    | text      = They do say that snitches get stitches.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:59.959
    | text      = I bet he's doing great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:02.959
    | text      = That was a more circumspect and subdued part of the day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:07.959
    | text      = Oh okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:08.959
    | text      = So that should give you some sense of where we're going.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:10.959
    | text      = Alright we're not going to be pronouncing words all the way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:13.959
    | text      = So before we get into anything here I need to clear up something that's caused a little bit of confusion.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:18.959
    | text      = There's a clip that people have posted online of Alex standing behind Owen where he's interrupting the show and being an asshole.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:24.959
    | text      = And at the end of it Owen is clearly pissed off and he tells the crew to get out of here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:30.959
    | text      = And he tells the crew we're going to rebroadcast.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:33.959
    | text      = Some people have posted it claiming it was the last day that Owen was there and it is the blow up and the walk out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:40.959
    | text      = But that's not correct.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:41.959
    | text      = In that video Owen's wearing a black shirt and Alex is in a t-shirt.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:45.959
    | text      = But this is from before Owen's hiatus.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:48.959
    | text      = That clip is from the war room on August 7th.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:51.959
    | text      = This was one of the other times that Alex has barged in and annoyed Owen during his show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:55.959
    | text      = But it wasn't the day that Owen walked out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:57.959
    | text      = It's very understandable that people would think that that was the event because it looks exactly like what Owen described.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:03.959
    | text      = But it's a different day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:04.959
    | text      = And if you watch that episode of the war room they just go to commercial.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:09.959
    | text      = And when Owen comes back he's doing a really anti-Semitic character with a tinfoil yarmulke talking about how Alex attacked him because he converted to Judaism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:18.959
    | text      = So like they were doing a bit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:20.959
    | text      = The annoyance and Owen saying let's go to rebroadcast I don't think was a bit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:25.959
    | text      = But they turned it into a bit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:26.959
    | text      = Right right right right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:27.959
    | text      = Well I mean that makes sense since part of the reason that Owen did the whole thing was because when he went on the hiatus he came back and he had the exact same problem.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:36.960
    | text      = So I mean one to one is you know usually you say the exact same problems and you figure you know it's kind of the same kind of problem.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:43.960
    | text      = It feels like that is the exact same thing that happened.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:45.960
    | text      = Yeah you can I'm sure if you were to dig through the war room archives you could find other instances of this too.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:52.960
    | text      = Like I'm sure that that wasn't the only time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:54.960
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:55.960
    | text      = But yeah some people have I've seen some posts that are along the lines of like Dan said nothing happened and this looks like something happened.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:05.960
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:06.960
    | text      = And it's a different day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:08.960
    | text      = There are a lot of things on this camel's back.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:13.960
    | text      = You know?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:14.960
    | text      = Over the years if you work with Alex you're going to have a lot of things on the back.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:18.960
    | text      = That day August 7th is an avatar of the day he walked out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:24.960
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:25.960
    | text      = It's the same thing it's just not that day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:26.960
    | text      = Right right right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:27.960
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:28.960
    | text      = So on our last episode we discussed the earth shattering news that Owen Schroyer had left Infowars and covered his five hour stream talking about how he was going to be the next Rush Limbaugh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:36.960
    | text      = It was a painful look at a man completely given over to unearned confidence and our take on it was generally that Owen deserved to get fired but that Alex was obviously creating a hostile work environment that Owen shouldn't have been subjected to and it's wrong.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:50.960
    | text      = From a human resources standpoint it wasn't really all that complicated but from an emotional and psychological level it was a mess.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:57.960
    | text      = Owen clearly felt undervalued and he believed that he could launch his own network and that he was entitled to be allowed to promote it on Infowars even after he'd stormed out on his own show and made some pretty unreasonable demands from his boss.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:09.960
    | text      = That boss, Alex, just told him to get lost and not come back so Owen did the only thing he could.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:15.960
    | text      = Tried to launch the network on his own by creating a media moment out of leaving Infowars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:20.960
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:21.960
    | text      = And he really really fucked up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:23.960
    | text      = But when we were recording the last episode it wasn't clear how badly he'd fucked up yet.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:28.960
    | text      = Whether or not he'd fucked up relied on how Alex took his comments.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:32.960
    | text      = Owen had hoped that Alex would be chill about it and not respond.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:35.960
    | text      = Maybe they could just both move on and be classy towards each other.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:38.960
    | text      = That'd be nice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:39.960
    | text      = Everyone could take the high road why not?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:40.960
    | text      = I mean we've worked together for ten years there's no way I would know that he wouldn't do something like that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:44.960
    | text      = But there's so much room on the high road. It's why.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:46.960
    | text      = Absolutely. That's for everybody.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:48.960
    | text      = Owen thought that he was being magnanimous in his stream and definitely said that he didn't have anything bad to say about Alex multiple times.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:55.960
    | text      = But underneath the surface he was constantly insulting Alex and promising that his new show wasn't just going to be wall to wall ads and permanent going out of business sales.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:04.960
    | text      = He was trying to elevate his future show by defining it as an alternative to Infowars where Infowars is all just manipulative advertising.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:13.960
    | text      = He also totally fucked up in terms of answering questions about Alex controlling his content while he worked there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:20.960
    | text      = If he wanted to make a clean break and expected Alex to be cool about it he needed to toe the party line and just say Alex never told me what to say I was free as a bird.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:28.960
    | text      = Anything short of that is suspicious and because Owen gave answers that acknowledged things like how Alex would be mean to him at work because he was too negative about Trump.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:36.960
    | text      = The stream left viewers with the impression that Alex exerted a very strong but maybe passive aggressive editorial influence on his staff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:44.960
    | text      = Owen thought he could say the words I have nothing bad to say about Alex a bunch and that would make up for his actions which were intensely negative towards Alex and Infowars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:54.960
    | text      = And it almost worked.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:56.960
    | text      = On the morning of September 2nd Alex woke up to find that Owen had made this quitting video and it probably wasn't a huge surprise to him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:04.960
    | text      = Owen did that stream after having a call with Alex so Alex knew that he had quit and they exist in a media space where it's like you have to act fast.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:13.960
    | text      = If you're surprised by this you haven't been alive for your entire life.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:17.960
    | text      = Alex had to know like well he's a free agent he's going to do what he needs to do he's probably going to make a video.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:22.960
    | text      = But Alex didn't watch Owen's video and he thought it was just a quitting announcement so he posted a response on Twitter at about 6.30 in the morning.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:31.960
    | text      = Quote, Owen has wanted to go for a while. He told me he was quitting yesterday afternoon. He told me if I needed him another week he would do it and I said no. It's that simple.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:40.960
    | text      = I built Infowars to be a radio talk show on TV. The office is a newsroom so when big stuff would break I and others would bring stuff to the show producers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:49.960
    | text      = That's as far as me standing over his shoulder went except maybe twice a month walking onto the show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:55.960
    | text      = That's what we have always done on the shows including mine. I've known Owen for over nine years and love the guy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:01.960
    | text      = That said when I started to watch what he said last night online it was sad and I stopped.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:05.960
    | text      = I wish Owen all the best for his life and the great work he does fighting evil and promoting freedom.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:10.960
    | text      = I never censored him and agreed with 99% of what I saw him talk about.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:14.960
    | text      = I only encouraged him to be more positive in general about the fact that humanity has come a long way in the Great Awakening.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:21.960
    | text      = Bottom line he wants to be his own captain and I think that's great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:25.960
    | text      = I'm surprised by the censorship claim he's hinting at but he thinks he needs to say that to build his own show. That will be on him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:31.960
    | text      = As for me I'm taking the high road and will continue to promote Owen when I see cool stuff he does. Godspeed to Owen.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:38.960
    | text      = Okay so that was kind of what I thought he was going to say. I thought he was going to be really cool about this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:43.960
    | text      = I thought he was going to be nice. I thought they were going to have a nice clean break.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:46.960
    | text      = I mean it's a good thing that he does this in the morning. First thing gets it out of the way. That way he just puts it out of his mind. Doesn't think about it and we just move on. No big deal.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:55.960
    | text      = Because he probably just thought that what Owen's stream was was like a hey I'm launching my own thing. No disrespect. I'm going to be cool about this or whatever.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:04.960
    | text      = He hadn't watched any of it. He had no idea. And that made it a disappointing response. It's a little bit adult and it's kind of professional.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:11.960
    | text      = So people are going to let him know that he should not respond that way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:15.960
    | text      = It's offering slight push back on the points that are unacceptable. But it's clear that whatever Owen said didn't get under Alex's skin.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:23.960
    | text      = It looked like Owen was going to get what he wanted. For the two men to just be able to move on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:28.960
    | text      = But I stress when Alex wrote that tweet he hadn't watched what Owen said.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:32.960
    | text      = It's clear that someone had just told him some general impressions of the video so Alex probably thought it wasn't so bad. It'll be alright.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:40.960
    | text      = Owen did say that he had nothing bad to say about Alex and he hopes they can keep it classy at the beginning of the stream.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:45.960
    | text      = So maybe Alex saw that part and he understood the message that Owen was trying to send.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:49.960
    | text      = Owen saying that he hoped Alex would just say nothing and move on. It's sort of an offer of a deal.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:55.960
    | text      = It was Owen saying I'm not going to burn you if you don't burn me. And I can imagine Alex seeing that opening couple minutes of Owen's stream.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:02.960
    | text      = Hearing that and thinking I don't need to watch five hours of this shit. He's clearly indicating that he's playing ball.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:08.960
    | text      = But Owen said shit in that stream that he can't take back.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:11.960
    | text      = And later that morning Alex finally got around to watching some of the stream. And let's say the reviews were not good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:16.960
    | text      = Oh no!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:17.960
    | text      = Today we're walking through September 2nd on Infowars. All the shows, or as I'm choosing to call it, the Empire claps back.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:24.960
    | text      = Okay. Oh god.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:26.960
    | text      = The day begins at 8am when Harrison Smith checks in for the American Journal.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:31.960
    | text      = Harrison is basically the only main on-air talent remaining at Infowars other than Alex.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:36.960
    | text      = Now that Owen and Chase are both gone.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:38.960
    | text      = But it would be a mistake to say that the other two guys leaving has made Harrison the number two guy at the network.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:44.960
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:45.960
    | text      = As the talent has disappeared there have been some other shifts going on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:48.960
    | text      = One of the more noticeable ones being that Alex's son Rex has been popping up a lot more.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:53.960
    | text      = That painfully boring Good Morning Infowars show with Brianna Morello has started on Saturdays.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:59.960
    | text      = And that weird guy from Twitter, Nick Sortore, has taken over Chase's Sunday night show that would air after Alex's Sunday show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:05.960
    | text      = Okay. Gotcha.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:06.960
    | text      = So he's got an Infowars show now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:08.960
    | text      = Alright.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:09.960
    | text      = These kind of moves have highlighted the ultimate truth that Owen never understood.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:13.960
    | text      = And that is that Alex is Infowars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:16.960
    | text      = All of the other people who are there are just performers and they are replaceable regardless of how important they might feel on the day-to-day basis inside Infowars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:25.960
    | text      = The only thing that matters is Alex. If he's there, then it's Infowars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:30.960
    | text      = On day one it was just him. And that never changed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:34.960
    | text      = Ask Paul Joseph Watson how important he really was. Ask David Knight, Jason Burmas, Aaron Dykes, Leanne McAdoo, Ja'Carri Jackson.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:42.960
    | text      = All of them are replaceable props. And it's silly to think anything else.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:47.960
    | text      = Because a fair number of the past crew, these people, they got their jobs by winning a contest.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:52.960
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
